# Project Design Context

Hand-verified brief for this workspace. Machine-readable source: `.21st/design.json`.
`21st init --design-context --check` will report "drift" against this file — that is expected: the
constraints and decisions here are deliberately richer than what source auto-detection produces.
Re-run `--refresh` only if you are happy to lose them.

## Project

- Name: ai-core
- Product type: developer tooling workspace / dashboard
- Stack: react, tailwind-v4, vite, framer-motion, typescript
- Color mode: dark-first
- Density: comfortable

## Sources

- Tokens: `src/styles.css` (Tailwind v4 `@theme`, radial-gradient page background)
- Components: `src/components`, `src/components/ui`
- Assets: none
- Instructions: `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `TOOLKIT.md`

## Tokens

| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| Background | `#07070c` with indigo/teal radial glows |
| Surface | `bg-white/[0.04]` + `ring-1 ring-white/10` + `backdrop-blur-xl` |
| Text | `#e8e8f0` primary, `rgba(255,255,255,0.60)` muted |
| Accent | `#6d5efc` (indigo), `#3b82f6` (blue), success `#6ee7b7`, warning `#fcd34d` |
| Radius | pill `9999px`, sm `8px`, md `12px`, lg `16px`, xl `24px` |
| Spacing | 4px scale; card padding 20px; section gap 16px |
| Type | Inter / system sans; ui-monospace for data; headings weight 600 |
| Shadows | ring + blur, no heavy drop shadows |

## Motion

- Runtime: **framer-motion** — `import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion'`
- Defaults: `{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 200-320, damping: 18-30 }`
- Durations: micro 0.15s · standard 0.3s · max 0.5s; stagger 0.05–0.1s
- Animate `transform`, `opacity`, `filter` only; `prefers-reduced-motion` respected

## Components

- Installed: none yet — install from the 21st.dev registry with
  `npx @21st-dev/cli@latest add <author>/<slug>` (lands in `src/components/ui`)
- Preferred primitives: shadcn/ui (new-york), radix-ui, 21st.dev registry
- Patterns: translucent `rounded-2xl` cards; tinted `rounded-full` status pills; staggered list
  entrances; `AnimatePresence` overlays

## Constraints

### Must

- Search the 21st.dev registry before hand-writing a UI primitive
- Install registry components into `src/components/ui`
- Animate every interactive surface with framer-motion (springs, not linear easing)
- Use `AnimatePresence` for mount/unmount and `layout` for reorder/resize
- Dark-first surfaces built from the Tailwind v4 tokens above
- Accessible semantics: real buttons, labels, `focus-visible` states, sufficient contrast

### Avoid

- Inventing components that already exist in the registry
- Static interactive surfaces with no motion
- CSS keyframes where a framer-motion primitive exists
- Heavy drop shadows, pure-black backgrounds, gradient-text overuse
- Placeholder lorem ipsum or fake data tables in shipped UI
- New dependencies for what an installed package already covers

## Decisions

- **framer-motion is the single motion runtime** — one dependency covering springs, gestures,
  layout, and `AnimatePresence`.
- **Dark-first theme with translucent card surfaces** — matches the control-room aesthetic and stays
  readable across long agent sessions.
- **Component installs land in `src/components/ui`** — shadcn-compatible path so both the 21st.dev
  and shadcn CLIs work unmodified.
